Kids basketball in Copenhagen, ages 5 to 12

Basketball starts
here. And it's fun.

Kids basketball on Østerbro in Copenhagen. Talata Mini (ages 5 to 9) and Talata Junior (ages 10 to 12) train back to back in the same gym with the same coaches. The kids are moving the whole hour. If they are not having fun they will not come back, and we know it.

Book a free session

What is Talata Mini?

For 5 to 9 year olds who just want to play. Come once a week or twice, whatever suits your family. Small group, proper coaching, games built for how young they are.

The only thing that matters at this age is that your kid wants to come back next week. That's what we build toward.

Movement first

Your kid will be moving almost the whole hour. We do not run lines where nine kids stand and watch one.

Teamwork

Taking turns and backing each other up. Sounds small. At this age it is most of the job.

Ball control

The basics, pitched at what a 7 year old can actually manage rather than what looks good on a drill sheet.

Just have fun

We want your kid to love the game. Everything else comes later.

First time? Perfect.

Most kids who join have never played before. That's exactly who this is for.

We know your kid's name

Small group, so the coaches know every kid by name and know how each one learns.

Training schedule

We train Tuesday and Thursday at Strandvejsskolen and Saturday morning at Kulturhuset Indre By. Come once a week or more, whichever works for you. Each session is one hour and we run through the whole season.

Junior basketball for ages 10 to 12

Junior comes next, once the basics are there. Proper foundations and real decisions in games, and it leads straight into Academy when they are ready for it.

Every week
Mon 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen from 19 Oct, Tue + Thu 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By
Same gym, right after Mini: an easy pickup if you've got kids in both age groups. 1.800 kr / half-season.
Register for Junior

A good place to start: Academy U12 Camp

If your kid has never touched a basketball before, a camp is an easier way in than a regular session. Four days with other kids at the same level and nobody watching to see how good they are.

Academy U12 Camp is for ages 5 to 11 and runs Mon 12 to Thu 15 October over the autumn break, 09:30 to 14:30 Monday to Wednesday at Hafnia-Hallen. Tuesday mixes court time with a session upstairs in the middle of the day, and Thursday is game day with every age group, 12:30 to 14:30. Hot lunch included Monday to Wednesday, plus snacks and fruit. 1.195 kr. 35 places.

A lot of kids who come to a camp end up in the weekly sessions afterwards. The coaches already know them by then, so turning up on a Tuesday is not the same leap.

Want to try it first?

Your kid is welcome to come to any session for free. Same time, same place. Just show up. Or register below so we know to expect them.

Get in touch or sign up

Fill in the form and I'll get back to you with your day, time and gym. The first session is free and there is nothing to pay to come and try.

Once your child has been in the gym and it is a fit, I send you the Holdsport link and get them on the team properly. Already decided? Say so in the form and I'll send it straight away.

Age groups run from 1 October, so the date decides the team.

We show you the first session as soon as you send this, and email it too. Nothing to book.

What's next?

At 10, kids move from Mini into Talata Junior. Same gym, straight after Mini, with proper fundamentals and real decisions in games.

At 13 they move up to Talata Academy, where it turns into competitive basketball with league games and video review. Kids who came up through Mini and Junior already know the coaches, so the jump is not a shock.

Mini → Junior → Academy: when your child is ready to move up, we'll reach out and get them set up on the next team.
